messages:
Leah (CS): Hi team — kicking off BrightOak onboarding. They want a focused 3-week pilot: surface KB embeddings in agent UI, add suggested reply snippets, and demonstrate clear ROI for renewal (timeline ~55 days). Maya is the PM. Who can own integration, runtime, and enablement? :wave:

Maya (BrightOak): Thanks Leah. Success targets: 25% AHT reduction on targeted flows, embed precision@5 >0.7, and p95 latency <200ms. We'll provide sanitized KB + 48h transcripts by EOD tomorrow. Pilot start in 10 business days.

Sam (Solutions): I can own integration + prompt templates. Plan: Day0 access/schema, Day4 prototype endpoint + UI hook, Day10 retrieval tuning + evals. Need to confirm auth (API key vs mTLS) and token budget.

Ivy (Eng): I'll take runtime sizing + canary. Recommend hosted prototype with private fallback if compliance required. Action for Maya: send concurrent agents and peak qps.

Dante (Enablement): I'll prepare a 60m workshop + one-pager runbook. Need two power users to shadow the canary.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "BrightOak Onboarding Kickoff" in 48h with Maya, Leah, Sam, Ivy, Dante.

Leah (CS): Quick action list to pin:
- Sam: prototype + smoke tests (due Day5)
- Ivy: canary plan + sizing (due Day9)
- Dante: enablement materials (due Day14)
- Maya: KB export + session stats (due Day1)
Risks: procurement/renewal at ~Day55; embedding storage cost if full KB ingested. I'll post a one-pager after kickoff. :white_check_mark:
